summary: Dedicated tenant: Rollback button missing in Optimize config history UI (RBAC/feature-flag mismatch)
body:
Issue summary
- Pinecone Analytics (Dedicated, prod us-east) reports they cannot see the “Rollback” action/button in the Optimize → Config History view in the Redwood Console.
- They can view version history entries, but the per-version “Rollback to this version” action and the top-level “Rollback” CTA are not visible.

Customer impact
- Customer cannot quickly mitigate a bad optimization config change using the Console.
- Forces manual support/SRE intervention during an incident, increasing mitigation time.

Environment
- Deployment mode: Dedicated
- Console: prod
- Region/cluster: us-east (dedicated)
- Tenant: pinecone-analytics (dedicated)
- Affected users: Customer admins + on-call operators

Steps to reproduce (as reported)
1) Log in as customer admin.
2) Navigate to Console → Optimize → Config History for a route/model.
3) Observe version timeline is present.
4) Observe no Rollback button in the UI (neither in overflow actions nor version detail pane).

Expected
- If the user has appropriate permission (optimize.config.rollback) and rollback is enabled for the tenant/environment, show Rollback action with confirmation flow.

Actual
- Rollback action not shown.

Initial hypothesis
- UI is gated by both (a) feature flag and (b) RBAC permission checks. Dedicated tenant appears to have version history enabled but rollback disabled, or RBAC role mapping missing new permission.

Customer notes
- Customer referenced prior comms that “one-click rollback” was available for Dedicated. They are currently testing internal runbooks for incident response and need this to be reliable.

Attachments/links
- Customer provided screenshot showing Config History timeline without Rollback actions (attached in Jira UI; not exported here).
- Support triage thread: #support (internal) with reference to SUP-2431 (see comments).
comments: 2025-01-17 09:12 PT — Kira Thompson (Support) — Ticket created after customer email + screenshot. Tagging Console + Auth/RBAC. Customer asks if this is a permission issue or feature not enabled for Dedicated yet.

2025-01-17 09:26 PT — Chloe Martin (Console Backend) — Acknowledged. Can someone confirm if rollback endpoint is reachable for this tenant? If UI is hidden, it’s likely the Console backend permission check returning false or a tenant flag off.

2025-01-17 09:44 PT — Kaitlyn Nguyen (AuthN/Z) — Checked RBAC: pinecone-analytics “CustomerAdmin” role does NOT include optimize.config.rollback (it has optimize.config.apply + optimize.config.view). This permission was added recently and may not have been backfilled into dedicated templates. Suggest updating role mapping and re-sync.

2025-01-17 10:03 PT — Chloe Martin (Console Backend) — Confirmed Console is gating rollback action on BOTH: (1) permission optimize.config.rollback and (2) feature flag optimize_config_rollback_enabled. For pinecone-analytics: flag appears OFF while optimize_config_history_enabled is ON. That explains why history is visible but rollback is hidden.

2025-01-17 10:18 PT — Rafael Mendes (SRE On-call) — Verified control plane: rollback API endpoint is deployed in us-east, but feature flag disablement prevents UI and blocks Console backend from returning rollback links. This looks like a rollout config mismatch for Dedicated tenants.

2025-01-17 10:41 PT — Chloe Martin (Console Backend) — Proposed fix: enable optimize_config_rollback_enabled for this tenant + update dedicated role template to include optimize.config.rollback for CustomerAdmin (or a dedicated Operator role if we want stricter defaults). Will coordinate with Security Ops on default posture; for this customer, they explicitly requested it.

2025-01-17 11:05 PT — Fiona McCarthy (Security Ops) — OK to grant rollback permission to CustomerAdmin if customer requested and we have audit logging on rollback actions (we do). Please ensure justification is captured in audit metadata and advise customer to limit the role assignment.

2025-01-17 11:22 PT — Chloe Martin (Console Backend) — Enabled tenant flag optimize_config_rollback_enabled=true for pinecone-analytics (prod). Requested RBAC role mapping update via INT-911 for dedicated templates; for immediate unblock, added optimize.config.rollback to their CustomerAdmin role and forced RBAC cache refresh.

2025-01-17 11:49 PT — Kira Thompson (Support) — Customer confirmed Rollback button now appears after re-login. They can open the confirmation modal. They asked for confirmation that rollback attempts are audit-logged and exportable.

2025-01-17 12:10 PT — Chloe Martin (Console Backend) — Confirmed audit events emitted: rollback_attempted, rolled_back, rollback_failed. Can be viewed in Console audit log and exported to SIEM where configured. Linked Confluence page on audit event taxonomy in response draft.

2025-01-18 08:37 PT — Kevin Osei (Audit Log Export) — Validated that pinecone-analytics has audit export enabled to their webhook destination; rollback events will be included. No redaction issues expected (payload includes version ids + scope, not prompt content).

2025-01-20 09:03 PT — Kira Thompson (Support) — Closing loop: customer performed a test rollback in their staging scope and saw corresponding audit log entries. They requested we prevent this mismatch for future Dedicated tenants (history on, rollback off, and permissions missing). Keeping follow-ups linked.
resolution: Resolved by enabling the rollback feature flag for the tenant and correcting RBAC permissions so authorized users have optimize.config.rollback. Customer validated the Rollback UI is visible and audit logs are emitted/exported. Follow-up work tracked in linked issues to prevent recurrence.
root_cause: Dedicated tenant rollout configuration was inconsistent: optimize_config_history_enabled was enabled while optimize_config_rollback_enabled remained disabled, and the dedicated RBAC role template had not been backfilled to include the new optimize.config.rollback permission. The Console correctly hid rollback actions when either the flag or permission check failed.
next_steps: Backfill/standardize Dedicated role templates to include optimize.config.rollback where appropriate (or introduce a separate “Optimize Operator” role) (tracked in INT-911 / ENG-4830).
Add an internal health check to detect ‘history enabled but rollback disabled’ mismatches for tenants where rollback API is deployed, and surface in ops dashboard.
Update release checklist to include Dedicated flag parity checks when rolling out rollback UI.
Add Console tooltip/state explaining why rollback is hidden (missing permission vs feature disabled) to reduce support load.
